distractors.description: You might think that arrays start counting from 1, or that you can access an index beyond the array's declared size. However, arrays in Java are 0-based, meaning the first element is at index 0 and the last element of a four-element array is at index 3. Using index 4 will cause an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException because it tries to access a non-existent fifth element. This distractor highlights the importance of understanding array indexing in Java.
